reviews.author: Lena Long
reviews.text: A Wonderful Japanese Lunch in Manchester – Delicious Food and a Warm Welcome! I really enjoyed our lunch at Maki & Ramen in Manchester. It was exactly what I was in the mood for – sushi rolls and a delicious bowl of miso soup! My husband also suggested I try the chicken katsu curry, and I’m so glad he did. I absolutely loved it too. We visited with our two young daughters, and what I particularly appreciated was how genuinely welcoming everyone was. The staff chatted with our girls and made us feel completely comfortable. As any parent of young children knows, eating out can sometimes be a little stressful when someone starts crying or needs attention. But here, we never felt uncomfortable or that we were disturbing anyone. Quite the opposite – both the staff and other guests were wonderfully understanding. The restaurant itself is spacious, with a lovely modern design and an open kitchen where you can watch the chefs preparing your food right from your table. It’s also in a very convenient location in Manchester. And one detail I particularly loved was the welcome! As we entered, the staff greeted us by beating a large Japanese drum. Such a fun and memorable way to start a meal! Delicious food, a lively atmosphere and genuinely friendly service. We had a wonderful experience and would happily return.

reviews.author: Ellie Bleasdale
reviews.text: Today was my 5th visit to Maki & Ramen in Leeds, having previously really enjoyed the food and brought along different friends and family on each occasion. My only previous criticism would have been how close together the tables are. Unfortunately, tonight’s experience has completely changed my opinion. The service was extremely disappointing. We waited 15 minutes to be approached, so ended up ordering through the QR code on the table. After receiving our drinks and sharing some sushi, we waited around 35–40 minutes for our ramen. During this time, two tables who arrived after us had already received the exact same dishes. We were never asked if we wanted to order another drink either. When we eventually asked about our order, we were told the ticket hadn’t gone through to the kitchen and asked to show our email receipt. There was no apology, and nobody had checked whether we were enjoying our starter or offered us another drink while we waited. We then waited a further 15 minutes for our food. Having ordered the same ramen on all five visits, I was really disappointed with it. The broth was nowhere near as good as previously, and by this point the long wait and poor service had completely put me off. The only positive was that the karaage chicken was still as good as ever. To finish things off, when we asked to take the remaining food home, we were simply handed two containers to decant the ramen into ourselves. It’s such a shame that a restaurant I’ve previously enjoyed and recommended has left me feeling this way. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning or recommending it going forward. There are plenty of other places in Leeds serving great ramen, and the service tonight has completely put me off coming back. Unfortunately, due to us paying online we had already paid the full amount otherwise we’d have probably asked for the bill & left after the sushi. Then to finish the visit no one asked if we had enjoyed the food , apologised before we left or even said bye thanks for coming as any other restaurant would.

reviews.author: Martin Saliu-Yusuf
reviews.text: We had a fantastic evening overall. The food was really enjoyable, and the cocktails were honestly some of the best I’ve ever had. The restaurant has lovely decor and a great feel to it, making it a nice place to spend an evening. We visited on a Saturday night and were seated straight away, with quick service throughout. A special mention goes to Bing, who was an absolute pleasure. She was welcoming, attentive and consistently friendly, with a warm smile that made us feel genuinely looked after. She went above and beyond to ensure all our needs were met. I particularly appreciated how attentive she was, checking in at the right moments and asking whether we wanted to order anything else rather than leaving us to constantly catch someone’s attention. It’s those little details that make such a difference to the dining experience. The service from the entire team was brilliant, and Bing deserves particular recognition for the warmth and professionalism she brought to the evening. My only criticism would be the seating arrangements, as some tables are quite close together, which can make the dining experience feel a little cramped. We also had to move seats initially as we were directly underneath the air conditioning. However, these were relatively minor inconveniences in what was otherwise a very enjoyable evening. Overall, a great experience, fantastic cocktails and excellent customer service. Bing is a real credit to the restaurant, and I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.text: Amazing experience at Maki Shoreditch, great ambience, delicious food. Great service by Navin.

reviews.author: Jasi S
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) The food was unfortunately only average – I think it could easily be improved. Our appetizers arrived after the main courses, which is hard to explain given how quiet the restaurant was. The service was friendly. Unfortunately, the price was also difficult to justify. (Original) Das Essen war leider nicht mehr als durchschnittlich - ich denke das lässt sich leicht toppen. Unsere Vorspeisen kamen leider erst nach dem Hauptspeisen, was bei wenig Betrieb wenig erklärbar ist. Der Service war nett. Preislich leider auch nur schwer zu vertreten.

reviews.author: Sebastian Schwarz
reviews.text: did not live up to the reviews. Kind service but besides from that nothing to write home about. main dishes where served before the starters and we weren’t to happy with what we had chosen.

reviews.author: Veronica Hamid
reviews.text: Food and atmosphere were excellent. The food came to the table all separately with some of the group having finished when the other food came out. Several times chasing for the food. Kitchen staff should plan meal readiness times more adequately to ensure all food comes out together.

reviews.author: anni d
reviews.text: Quingxuan L was a very helpful and friendly server! Great first experience

reviews.author: Jamie Watts
reviews.text: My raman was amazing and the service was brilliant she goes by the name of xuan

reviews.author: GracieLou TDI
reviews.text: Xuan served us and she was lovely. The food was amazing, I’m so full and I only had a bunch of starter type food. Excellent, would recommend!

reviews.author: AS
reviews.text: Staff were all very friendly and helpful, especially Qingxuan who served us this evening. The Black Garlic Tonkatsu - I cannot describe how good it was! Perfect dish for the Autumnal season. Will definitely visit again soon.

reviews.author: Ianthe Jerreat
reviews.text: Qingxuan our server was absolutely lovely and so helpful. 10/10

reviews.author: Matt Lilburn
reviews.text: Great food

reviews.author: Jürgen Mayr
reviews.text: First of all, the service—especially Qingxuan L.—was extremely friendly and attentive, consistently checking in to make sure everything was alright and if we needed anything else. The sushi was excellent and of high quality; we would definitely come back again. The warm dishes were equally impressive and fully hit the mark.

reviews.author: Han
reviews.text: Impeccabile food and service everyone is so friendly the atmosphere is 10/10 would definitely recommend. Thank you to our servers Christopher, Smiti, Alice, Xuan and Yilia

reviews.author: Jazz Mullins
reviews.text: First time visiting Maki & Ramen in Southampton today, absolutely fantastic time ! Each server who helped us was super friendly, helpful and made the experience very joyous/ humorous! We will definitely be back - special thanks to Christopher, Xuan, Smiti, Yiala and Alice, impeccable service ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: brian ham
reviews.text: Really good service from xuanh amazing Thank you

reviews.author: Chris Johnson
reviews.text: Had a really nice lunch at Maki & Ramen, will definitely be coming back to try more of the delicious food. Can highly recommend the Tonkatsu ramen. The service was great as well, fast ordering and great atmosphere. Big shout out to Xuan H for looking after us!

reviews.author: Babygirl 25
reviews.text: Stunning food and fabulous service from Qingxuan L thank you for looking after us will come again xx

reviews.author: Cheng Adah
reviews.text: Food was delicious. Service was really great. Ginger and Jada were over the top! Super friendly!

reviews.author: Adam Usmani
reviews.text: Excellent meal! We really enjoyed the selection of hand rolls and also the Omakase. Everything was really fresh and full of flavour. We also got a few hot plates too which were great. The service was exceptional. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a Japanese meal!

reviews.author: ccgyozalover
reviews.text: 🥢Crudo – Scallop & Akami 🍣 Hand Rolls – Negitoro, Hamachi & Snow Crab 🥩 Premium Nigiri – A5 Wagyu & Chutoro 🍱 Tokusei 15pcs Chef’s Selection ⭐️ The hand rolls were definitely the star of the show! Each one is made to order and served immediately, giving you that perfectly crisp, freshly rolled nori with every bite. The combination of sushi rice, fresh toppings and crunchy nori was just 👌 Beyond the hand rolls, Maki Nori also has a great selection of crudo and premium nigiri, with high-quality ingredients that really speak for themselves.

reviews.author: Nathan Fernandes
reviews.text: Fake Aesop in the bathroom, room temperature sushi, and Instagram flair. No I don’t want dry ice smoke effect with my sushi. At least it was cheap.

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.text: Everything was absolutely perfect! Highly recommend everyone to try salmon crudo 🔥🔥🔥

reviews.author: Cindy Wolf
reviews.text: We stumbled upon this delightful restaurant and are so happy we did. The food was outstanding and beautifully presented. The staff were pleasant and attentive. Will definitely be going back!
